t: gave an account of, a thing different from that respecting which he was asked.

.] It was said to ElAsadeeyeh, “ What is
أَنْ يَلِيتَ الإِنْسَانُ شَيْئًا قَدْ عَلِمَهُ
, i. e., “ The concealing a thing that one knows, and telling, or narrating, something different from it. ” (TA.) ― -b2-
and related what was different therefrom.
narrated to him, a thing in a manner different from the real state of the case:
concealed it from him, telling him, narrating to him,
giving him an account of, a thing different from that respecting which he was asked:
, signifies “ he expressed to him the news, or information, obscurely, or enigmatically, or obscured it to him, or concealed it from him ”: thus he makes it belong to art.
: and the like is said in the L. See also above. (TA.) ― -b4-
averted him, from his course, purpose,

maqayis: اللام والواو والتاء لست أحق صحته، وليس هو من كلامهم عندي، لكن ناسا زعموا أنه يقال: لات يلوت، إذا أخبر بغير ما سئل عنه. ويقولون: اللوت: الكتمان. وفيهما نظر.
